credentials.emptyBody: A certificate is issued only when every Program A requirement is met. Nothing here replaces a professional licence.

licence.title: Professional licence status
licence.note: A separate field from your certificates. A passed exam or a valid certificate does not mean you hold a valid licence.
licence.pendingRequest: A change to “{{status}}” was requested on {{date}} and is pending until the CRM acknowledges it.

cpd.title: CPD ledger
cpd.description: Earned, pending approval and required CPD for the demo cycle. Only earned and approved amounts count towards the target.
cpd.remaining: {{value}} {{unit}} still needed to reach the target.
cpd.targetMet: The CPD target for this cycle is met.
cpd.empty: No CPD has been recorded yet.

renewal.title: Certificate renewal
renewal.description: Complete the checklist to earn a new credential.
renewal.neverExtended: Renewal never extends your current certificate. A new credential is issued and the old one stays in your record as Superseded.
renewal.notEligible: Renewal opens when a certificate is expiring soon or has expired.
renewal.startExpiring: Your certificate is expiring soon. Start the renewal checklist: refresher course, renewal check and the remaining CPD.
renewal.startExpired: Your certificate has expired. Starting renewal assigns a short retraining path before the refresher course and the renewal check.
renewal.retrainingExpired: Short retraining path assigned because the certificate expired.
renewal.retrainingFailed: Short retraining path assigned because the renewal check was not passed. Finish it to try again.

retraining.title: Short retraining path
retraining.detail: Three short lessons on service basics, visitor needs and recovery.

refresher.title: Refresher course
refresher.detail: A short refresher on the programme essentials. Earns {{value}} {{unit}} of CPD.

assessment.title: Renewal check
assessment.detail: Five scenario questions. You need {{percent}}% to pass.

cpd.title: Remaining CPD
cpd.done: The CPD target for this cycle is met.
cpd.how: Earn it from the refresher course or add an external certificate and wait for approval.

check.title: Renewal check
check.intro: Answer every question. The pass mark is {{percent}}% (a demo setting).
check.unanswered: Answer all questions before submitting. Still open: {{n}}.

q1.prompt: A visitor asks for a family activity. What do you do first?
q1.b: Ask about the family’s interests and practical needs.
q1.c: Give them a printed list and move on.

q2.prompt: A tour is delayed by an hour. How do you recover the moment?
q2.c: Tell guests early, apologise, explain the new plan and offer an option.

q3.prompt: A guest shares a passport photo by messaging app. What is right?
q3.a: Do not keep it; explain the secure way to share documents.
q3.b: Save it to your phone for later.
q3.c: Forward it to colleagues who might need it.

q4.prompt: You are unsure about an opening time. What do you do?
q4.b: Check the official source before answering.
q4.c: Tell the guest it is probably open.

q5.prompt: A guest uses a wheelchair. Which approach is best?
q5.a: Choose an itinerary for them without asking.
q5.b: Assume they will not want activities.
q5.c: Ask what access they need and adapt the plan together.

renewal.checkFailed: Renewal check not passed ({{percent}}%). A short retraining path is assigned.
renewal.complete: Complete renewal and issue new credential
renewal.completeHint: Finish every step to enable this.
renewal.issued: Renewal complete. A new credential was issued.
renewal.completedBody: Your earlier certificate is kept in your record as Superseded. It was not extended.
renewal.failed: This step could not be saved. Try again.

external.title: External certificates
external.description: Certificates you earned elsewhere. Submit one for review; it counts towards your CPD only after it is approved.
external.distinct: External evidence is shown separately and is never an Academy credential.
external.formDescription: Provide the details and attach the evidence as a PDF. Demo data only.
external.emptyBody: Add a certificate from another provider to claim CPD for it.
external.evidenceFailed: The evidence file could not be opened.
external.submitted: Submitted — Pending review. No CPD is added until it is approved.
external.submitFailed: The certificate could not be submitted. Try again.
external.pendingNote: After you submit, this certificate stays Pending review and adds no approved CPD.
external.infoSent: Information sent. The certificate is back in review.

next.pending: Wait for the review. No CPD is counted yet.
next.verified: {{value}} {{unit}} of CPD is now in your ledger.
next.rejected: Read the reviewer note. You can submit a corrected certificate.

errors.dateOrder: The expiry date must be after the issue date.

list.title: Certificates
list.description: Watermarked demonstration certificates for the Program A certification track. They are training records, not licences.
list.noTrackBody: Certificates appear only for a certification-track programme. Program B builds everyday skills and has no certificate. Program A, Tourism Service Professional, ends with a demonstration certificate.
list.noTrackBodyB: Program B builds everyday skills and has no certificate. Your Program A certificate and its progress show when Program A is active.
list.onItsWayTitle: Your certificate is on its way
list.onItsWayBody: The system checks every required condition and issues the demonstration certificate automatically: foundation quiz at least 80, an attended session scored at least 70, an approved assignment at least 70 and a final assessment at least 80.
